newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Montreal Q2 loan losses flat.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Montreal Q2 loan losses flat.

text.p: Bank of Montreal said on Tuesday that its second-quarter loan losses were unchanged at C$69 million from the second quarter last year for a total annual loan loss provision of C$275 million.

"The current forecast provision of $275 million is unchanged from the level forecast at this time last year, but up C$50 million from the final 1996 level of C$225 million," the bank said in a statement.
It said early asset quality reviews suggested a favorable trend for loan losses, but the bank would not finalize its loan loss provisions until it reported in the third quarter.
Net impaired loans were reduced by C$717 million from the end of second quarter last year to a nil balance at the end of the same quarter this year.
